tagline: Official AWS docs search and reading for remote teammates — no credentials, public data only.
requirements: No credentials needed — the server reads public AWS documentation (set AWS_DOCUMENTATION_PARTITION to cn or us-gov for those partitions). This is the official AWS Labs server.

tools.name: read_documentation
tools.note: Reads a docs page as markdown.

tools.name: read_sections
tools.note: Reads selected sections of a long page.

seo.description: Share the official AWS Documentation MCP server with MCPWire. No credentials required — let teammates search and read AWS docs over P2P with a fully read-only toolset.
